units.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Cpp reads and writes Excel .xlsx workbooks. It provides classes such as Workbook, Worksheet, and Cell to create, modify, and save spreadsheets programmatically. It supports styling with Style, Font, Color, FillPattern, and Borders.
It constructs blank workbooks or loads existing .xlsx files from paths or in-memory streams, then saves them back to .xlsx using Workbook.Save, and WorkbookSaveException is raised when saving fails.

It writes values of strings, integers, doubles, booleans, and DateTime to cells via Cell.PutValue, retrieves values as variant-typed CellValue with typed accessors, and stores or reads formulas via Cell.SetFormula and Cell.GetFormula.

It applies cell styles by retrieving and setting Style objects that bundle Font, FillPattern, Color, Borders, alignment, and text wrap, and Style provides clone and getter methods for each formatting component.
It controls worksheet visibility with VisibilityType, manages gridlines and headers, and protects worksheets using WorksheetProtection, all exposed directly on Worksheet.
It applies conditional formatting through ConditionalFormattingCollection and FormatCondition, and manages data validation via ValidationCollection and Validation, both scoped to CellArea ranges.
It configures page setup with PageSetup for paper size, orientation, margins, scaling, print area, headers, footers, and page breaks, using PageOrientationType and PaperSizeType enumerations.

It attaches hyperlinks to cell ranges via HyperlinkCollection and Hyperlink, supporting external, internal, and mailto links, and manages workbook- or sheet-scoped named ranges through DefinedNameCollection and DefinedName.

It exposes core and extended document metadata through WorkbookProperties, DocumentProperties, and ExtendedDocumentProperties, accessible via Workbook.GetProperties and Workbook.GetDocumentProperties.

This example creates a new workbook, adds a worksheet named Products, populates it with product names and prices, computes a SUM formula, applies a styled header, and saves the result as products.xlsx.

Aspose.Cells FOSS for Cpp provides the Workbook class as the root entry point for creating, loading, modifying, and saving XLSX workbooks, with Worksheet, Cells, and Cell forming the primary object graph beneath it. The library exposes additional collections and objects for formatting, validation, hyperlinks, defined names, page setup, and workbook properties.

The Workbook class serves as the root spreadsheet object used to create, load, modify, and save an XLSX workbook, supporting operations such as saving to a file or stream with a specified SaveFormat and throwing WorkbookSaveException on save failures or WorkbookLoadException on load failures.

The Worksheet class encapsulates a single worksheet and its supported features, providing access to cells, hyperlinks, validations, conditional formattings, page setup, and protection, with visibility, gridlines, zoom, and right-to-left settings controlled via methods such as SetName, SetVisibilityType, and SetZoom.

The Cell class represents a single worksheet cell and exposes value, formula, and style operations, allowing values of multiple types—including DateTime—to be written via PutValue and retrieved as a variant-typed CellValue, with style applied and read via GetStyle and SetStyle.

The ConditionalFormattingCollection class represents a collection of conditional formatting objects, supporting the addition of format conditions with a specified FormatConditionType and OperatorType, and allowing each FormatCondition to define its priority, stop-if-true behavior, and Style.

The ValidationCollection class represents a collection of validation objects, supporting the addition of validation rules to cell areas with a specified ValidationType and OperatorType, and allowing error message and title to be configured via properties such as ShowError, ErrorTitle, and ErrorMessage.

The HyperlinkCollection class encapsulates the hyperlinks defined for a worksheet, supporting the addition of hyperlinks to a cell area with an address, and allowing text to display and screen tip to be set via properties on the Hyperlink object.

The DefinedNameCollection class represents a collection of defined name objects, supporting the addition of defined names with a formula and optional local sheet index, and allowing a comment to be stored on each DefinedName.

The PageSetup class represents worksheet print and page-layout settings, supporting orientation and paper size via PageOrientationType and PaperSizeType, fit-to-page options, print area, title rows or columns, header and footer text, and horizontal or vertical page breaks.

The Style class represents a mutable cell style facade that can be applied to one or more cells, allowing font, borders, fill pattern, foreground and background colors, number format, horizontal alignment, and wrap text to be configured via dedicated getters and setters.

The WorkbookProperties class represents workbook properties, with DocumentProperties and ExtendedDocumentProperties providing access to core and extended metadata, respectively, and WorkbookSettings controlling workbook-level settings that affect date handling and display formatting.
It adds support for legacy XLS/XLSB, CSV, ODS, PDF rendering, and full-fidelity conditional-formatting and AutoFilter round-tripping.
CellValue class provides methods to access cell values as different types, including AsBool, AsDateTime, AsDouble, AsInteger, AsString, IsBool, and IsDateTime.
DateTime class provides methods to construct and compare date-time values, including DateTime, Equals, GetDay, GetHour, GetMinute, GetMonth, GetSecond, and GetTicks.
CaseInsensitiveEqual class provides case-insensitive equality comparison for string keys.
CaseInsensitiveHash class provides case-insensitive hash computation for string keys.
